verdicts.proof: Old detail renders RouteReviewsSection at route_detail_screen.dart:326; the v2 detail renders the same widget at v2/route_detail_view_v2.dart:204, and the widget itself branches to RouteReviewsSectionV2 (route_reviews.dart:344-348) using the same state, the same _openEditor (login check) and the same _delete. No other v2 entry to the section.

bookingRidesProvider returns [] when logged out (ride_provider.dart:26, same in 70a94933) and BookingRidesSection returns SizedBox.shrink when empty (ride_booking_section.dart:30-31) before any MgV2 branch; only the header differs (:42-43). The only caller is res_detail_tab_content.dart:354 (same as 70a94933:405), and v2 reservation detail reuses ResDetailTabContent (reservations/v2/res_detail_view_v2.dart:97). Silent in both looks.

Old login check in _ReviewsSheetState._openEditor (route_reviews.dart:149-153) and _RouteReviewsSectionState._openEditor (:305-309), unchanged vs 70a94933. All v2 write buttons call these: sheet footer MgBtnInk onTap: onWrite (route_reviews_v2.dart:251-254) wired to _openEditor at route_reviews.dart:181; section block MgBtnGhostLight onTap: onWrite (route_reviews_v2.dart:186-190) wired at route_reviews.dart:347. The sheet is opened only through showRouteReviewsSheet (v2 route card onReviews routes_screen.dart:1518, old card :1679, navigation :1763). The v2 hero rating chip (route_detail_parts_v2.dart:135) has no tap. Same snackbar text in both looks.

_submit checks _rating < 1 -> snackbar routeReviewRatingReq (route_reviews.dart:471-474). The v2 editor is built by the same _ReviewEditorState (:504-514) and its only send button calls onSubmit = _submit (review_editor_v2.dart:87). Initial rating 0 for a new review in both looks (:442).

Old: onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit (route_reviews.dart:572). v2: MgBtnInk(busy: busy, onTap: busy ? null : onSubmit) (review_editor_v2.dart:87) with busy = _busy (route_reviews.dart:512); MgBtnInk treats busy or null onTap as disabled and shows a spinner (core/v2/widgets/mg_buttons.dart:42,61).
uid == null -> return at route_reviews.dart:469-470 inside _submit, which is the only v2 send path (review_editor_v2.dart:87 -> route_reviews.dart:513). Silent in both looks.

catch block resets _busy and shows routeReviewErr snackbar (route_reviews.dart:491-497); v2 send goes through the same _submit (:513), editor stays open since onSaved is only called on success (:490).

_upload returns null on error (route_reviews.dart:456-466) and only non-null URLs are added (:478-481); v2 photo button calls the same _pick (review_editor_v2.dart:101-105 -> route_reviews.dart:511) and send the same _submit. Silent in both looks.

Old labels from _my (route_reviews.dart:226-228, :386-388), editor prefilled from existing: _my (:164, :320, :441-444). v2 labels from d.my which is the same _my (route_reviews.dart:180, :346 -> route_reviews_v2.dart:187, :252); v2 editor title from widget.existing (:506) and same prefilled state. Server upsert unchanged.

Old delete only in section when _my != null (route_reviews.dart:394-402 -> _delete :331-341), none in sheet. v2: delete shown only if d.my != null && onDelete != null (route_reviews_v2.dart:193-194); the section passes onDelete: _delete (route_reviews.dart:348), the sheet passes none (:178-181, route_reviews_v2.dart:258). No confirmation in either look (equal). poi_reviews_v2.dart:30 reuses the block for places, not route reviews.

Old tile tints status=='hidden' red (route_reviews.dart:34,39). v2 card RtReviewCardV2 uses status=='hidden' -> MgColors.errBg (route_reviews_v2.dart:102); both v2 blocks render every review through RtReviewCardV2 (:182). Data from the same get_route_reviews call.

Old section: _loading -> spinner only, no write/delete (route_reviews.dart:350-353); errors set _loading=false (:297-301). v2 section: d.loading -> skeleton only, no buttons (route_reviews_v2.dart:165-170), same _loading flag (route_reviews.dart:346). In the quick sheet both looks show the write button during loading (old :211 before the _loading check at :235; v2 pinned footer :251) - equal behaviour.

PopScope(canPop: !_edited, onPopInvoked -> _leave) wraps the whole Scaffold for both looks (route_builder_screen.dart:257-261); _leave asks confirmDiscard (:73-82). v2 back disc BuilderTopBarV2 onBack: _leave (:350); old back :377. The builder route is outside the ShellRoute (core/router.dart:321-332 vs ShellRoute :371), so no tab bar can leave it; MgBackGuard there is look-independent. The only other navigation is context.push to /route-nav-custom (:248), which does not discard the builder. Note: this guard is new on this branch (not in 70a94933), applies to both looks.
